<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>RBI policy shift:</strong> The Reserve Bank of India has initiated its first repo rate hike in nearly four years, with projections suggesting the rate could reach 6% by FY27, putting pressure on housing affordability and mid-income buyers.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxOaHBfZmwzZ055OFBsUE9MSXRWUUhHalh4bHlrUnpDZmhSZ2w1dEU0bG8xQkFwWTd1SFgxQ2ppbHRGQzBOQ1BHdWFLcU9qRkVQenJLSnZfVUNpWVhFYWVzWmRRNnBYRWtqVGUwYkJRaEhWaG1TRFN1a1ZBRU9iTXBFcVN1NkE5NVFfUlZuTXNoNVJnNWJYU2gzTFhhclBBZw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxOdkFnODROd05YMVE3NFhJWkh6cWstdUJGUEI1em4tOUNpTlpEOTNBalA3N2w5eWdpU1lzRjhYbGZfSkhINzRlc25IVi1jV1NVT0RwSFRHektBa05LSHFBdnFackNncFBGSXVnUFFqWWc0RnBDdzBTT0Racjl2WVhTS2ZmQ01IMFFZRVZTUjJJSTBJRVU1MGt3X2hWUUJ2Mk5qZ3Z4blF4Tng?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixwFBVV95cUxOa2dBNFlOeTJDSWJYVF85MXVxNUtiVE5HMl8xZjB5N1MzQWt3WXA5b0FwaTZraWdJNU81eDNpd0lsbDRFUS12WUpsSERFdWxCcThteUxCVlVoYm9raWJXWGk1MnZvLUZnaVBUR3Exajh0UnpxMUFLUEpNbU9GZGxpVkU2VU5tclFWdVNNeGpidlJZR0F6WjVkXzNVR2RwS0RROVVsSGVKNGM3WnJqeXFqdFVzcy1Vb2FRYVJEdFNxNThONjhaUFBv?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market reaction:</strong> Domestic indices faced significant selling pressure, with the Sensex shedding 430 points and the Nifty losing 173 points following the central bank&#x27;s decision to tighten monetary policy.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxQMFlYUERYRl9wclBKcTY4QjY5OC04Yl9oNm8tLWJ4QkRGUkZPamZrcHlVZklNX2ZYYWJhN2RXZHJQS0tZYlgtQ0N3MVp0eVVEVi11RDllWjItbXFEUHdlUXNHQWFEVllrbmhrTlUtVkh3amRuTFZDRWtiZzNsSGNRc0w2RXZCV3M5VVFvT0xMeDBYeTJFQ1JKQ2tJTWl2MjNqRFNZeTJaeDdNc0FKSERnMTdkdWFJd3hGblRrdXBFaw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Currency intervention:</strong> The RBI has implemented measures to curb speculation and tighten rules for forex bets as it intervenes to support the rupee, which has neared 97 against the dollar amid a $52 billion decline in forex reserves.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Macroeconomic headwinds:</strong> Global market sentiment remains sensitive to rising bond yields and crude oil price fluctuations, which directly impact the efficacy of the RBI’s efforts to stabilize the rupee while maintaining economic growth.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>External drivers:</strong> Investors are looking toward upcoming US inflation data and major bank earnings as key catalysts that will likely dictate the direction of global equity markets in the week ahead.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxPOWFEYlRPWTlMWV9XRzRZb3dyekxmUXJaTFJBS2p1SjhhWmJuN1BBSHdGN2VDM0tBaVBjR080enpuMERzRlBwaEdBUV9GbjhkaXItNkpVUGFETkFsNk5VMXBxZnRCQThQWmxKNXhaWGF3YTNKTldITTJWVy1FNV9fdHhHWEVzUndVMVF2Ull4V2Y5TldhWjh5ejZwUU1fVWwzdHJ0R3dhTTU?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a></span></li>
